# Decision — CASE-001

**Recommendation: Split: 5,000 bridge from Kugellager Bayern GmbH (road) + 31,000 from Rulmenti Est SRL (road)** — landed EUR 50117.30 (EUR 1.3921/pc), full quantity on site 2026-09-15.

PO-2291 (30 000 pcs, Kugellager Bayern) slipped from 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-17. On-hand cover is 12 days at the ASSY-3 take rate of 350/day.

## Why this plan

- The line stops on 2026-09-03 at EUR 18400.00/hour. This plan keeps it running; EUR 5299200.00 of downtime avoided against the cheapest plan that does not.
- 5,000 pcs from Kugellager Bayern GmbH by road, ETA 2026-09-03; 31,000 pcs from Rulmenti Est SRL by road, ETA 2026-09-15. Landed EUR 50117.30; line keeps running.
- Runner-up `STR-04` (Split: 5,000 bridge from Kugellager Bayern GmbH (air) + 31,000 from Rulmenti Est SRL (road)): +EUR 1896.39, full qty 2026-09-15, feasible.
- Runner-up `STR-05` (Split: 5,000 bridge from SKF Deutschland Vertrieb GmbH (road) + 31,000 from Rulmenti Est SRL (road)): +EUR 2676.04, full qty 2026-09-15, feasible.
- Runner-up `STR-06` (Split: 5,000 bridge from SKF Deutschland Vertrieb GmbH (air) + 31,000 from Rulmenti Est SRL (road)): +EUR 4576.49, full qty 2026-09-15, feasible.

## What the suppliers actually said

| supplier | stock | offered | lead | confidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SUP-KBY | in_stock_allocated | 12,000 | 12 d | 73% |
| SUP-RUL | to_be_made | 36,000 | 24 d | 87% |
| SUP-SKF | in_stock_allocated | 8,000 | 6 d | 85% |

`in_stock_allocated` is why the offered quantity can be far below what was first said to be in stock. Our files are the baseline; a claim never silently overwrites them.

## What a human still owns

- Approving this PR is the approval. Nothing was ordered.
- Policy: `policy_report.md`. Cost arithmetic: `cost_report.md`. Event log: `events.jsonl`.

# Policy report — CASE-001

`6204-2RS` (rolling_bearing, high criticality), 36,000 pcs needed by 2026-09-03. Screened 6 approved suppliers on 2026-08-22.

**3 cleared, 3 rejected.**

| supplier | country | verdict | rule | why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kugellager Bayern GmbH | DE | cleared | — | approved for 6204-2RS, incumbent, preferred, contract EUR 1.42/pc, 10d door-to-door |
| Ningbo Precision Bearing Co. Ltd | CN | rejected | `blocked_origin_country` | CN is on the blocked-origin list (CN, RU, BY, IR, KP). |
| Pulman AG | DE | rejected | `missing_required_certification` | rolling_bearing requires ISO_9001, DIN_625_CONFORMITY; SUP-PUL ISO_9001, DIN_625_CONFORMITY lapsed on 2026-03-31. |
| Rulmenti Est SRL | RO | cleared | — | approved for 6204-2RS, contract EUR 1.30/pc, 21d door-to-door |
| NordBearing Trading ApS | DK | rejected | `audit_required_and_not_audited` | 6204-2RS is high criticality, which requires an on-site audit; SUP-NBT is never_audited. |
| SKF Deutschland Vertrieb GmbH | DE | cleared | — | approved for 6204-2RS, contract EUR 1.95/pc, 6d door-to-door |

A rejection cites the rule that produced it, and every rule reads one field of `company_profile.yaml`. Nothing here is a judgement call by the agent.
